searchText: Hey guys, is there a widget which tracks ETH gas prices in real time? gasnow.org has some widget tools I just simply stick to simpler statements these days. "EIP-1559 is not expected to decrease gas prices in any significant way." I believe this is a generally true statement, and while there is some nuance around reducing overpayment, it isn't a significant portion of gas prices I don't think. And such a statement leaves people with what I believe is a *more correct* intuition than when I was giving them the whole nuanced argument. how low can basefee go? would 1 gwei per gas be possible? it seems that there must be at least 1 gwei per gas for miners + basefee. so wondering how low it can go since basefee is controlled by an algorithm i wonder if it will ever be able to scoop up low paying transactions. it might be too slow compared to today where fees spiked down to 4 gwei for example. thats actually quite effecient and people who are patient got rewarded. i wonder if eip1559 will ever be able to do this. time will tell i guess It reacts smoothly, but it can react quickly when it needs too okay lets hope 4 gwei fees and lower will not be a thing of the past post eip1559 Here is a dramatic example of the system re-calibrating after spamming the test network That is a log based graph as well the window of oppertunity for extremely low fees are usually really short. i am concerned that these oppertunities will cease to exist post eip1559 because it will be too slow to adjust down but time will tell Can you quantify what you mean by really short? fees spike down as well as up eip1559 removes the spikes afaik earlier today it was 4 gwei per gas now its back at 24 gwei. i wonder if those spikes to 4 gwei per gas would happen post eip1599 🙂 time will tell How long defines a spike I mean a few blocks, a few minutes, an hour? today there is no formal definition. but with eip1559 it gets defined with the algorithm. basically how fast or slow it wants to adjust How long was the 4 gwei spike? less than 16 hours Yeah, it doesn't adjust that slowly if you said a minute or two, then I am not sure
